goal: Add the local Interaction channel: the daemon writes requests under its state directory, every Host lists them through loop_interactions and answers them only through the privileged answer_loop_interaction tool's native confirmation, selected by loop.interaction.channel, per D4 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-7, BR-SCN-2; meet D4 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-interaction-local.test.ts over the local channel, the shared MCP tool runtime and the Pi tool registration. Done looks like: with loop.interaction.channel local, a pending Lane decision appears in loop_interactions, an answer confirmed through answer_loop_interaction is applied through the Lane decision relay and the Lane continues on the next tick. Negative: an answer file without the privileged tool's confirmation record is ignored; an answer to a stale request is refused; a plan_approval request is never answered by the tool and points to drive. Bound: loop.interaction.channel other than github or local is config_invalid; absent means github.
